findings.desc: CHK-002:adversarial:0 intent requires demonstrating the selfcheck exits with code 1 when an assertion fails, but the bound evidence command (node experiments/recovery-runner/make-fig-gate-ablation-selfcheck.mjs) only runs the passing selfcheck (exits 0 with 38 assertions passed). The note says the exit-1 path was implementer-verified by manually breaking an assertion, which is not reproducible by re-running the bound command. A runnable one-liner that injects a deliberate failure (e.g. node -e "..." or a temp fixture) and asserts exit code 1 would properly bind this intent.
